name: template-ia
description: Monorepo do template — API (backend/) e painel (frontend/). Cada app tem o seu bun.lock e o seu node_modules; a raiz só orquestra (sem dependências e sem node_modules).

scripts.install:all: bun install --cwd backend && bun install --cwd frontend
scripts.setup: bun run env:init && bun run install:all && bun run db:up && bun run db:reset && echo '✓ Pronto: bun run dev:api (API :3080) e bun run dev:front (painel :3000). Login fslab.vilhena@ifro.edu.br / 102030fs'
scripts.env:init: ([ -f backend/.env ] || cp backend/.env.example backend/.env) && ([ -f frontend/.env.local ] || cp frontend/.env.example frontend/.env.local)
scripts.check: bun run --cwd backend typecheck && bun run --cwd backend test && bun run --cwd backend lint && bun run --cwd frontend typecheck && bun run --cwd frontend lint
scripts.types: bun run --cwd backend openapi:export && bun run --cwd frontend types:file
